ANALYZE_PDMX.current_hypothesis: Why is PDMX slow and hitting low? Can we make it faster without losing hit rate?
ANALYZE_PDMX.key_evidence: Profiled: greedy_order=6.03s, sort=0.40s. 47 kept cols, greedy creating 100+ groups of binary splits. Tested different max_groups: max_groups=1 (global only)=0.77s+44.61%; max_groups=5=2.33s+44.61%; max_groups=50=4.46s+44.48%. Global scoring is FASTER AND BETTER for PDMX! Conditional grouping hurts PDMX because tiny groups create noise. For beer, global gives 55.7% vs conditional 71% - conditional IS needed for beer (to discover that beer_name should come 2nd within beer/style groups).
